annotations.title: Start hook tests for a post

description: Makes a hook test for each version (up to 3) in a post's edit list, on the post's Instagram accounts that have the Trial Reels autopilot on. Each version waits for its video (hook_test_media_set) and for approval. Safe to repeat: a version already tested is left alone.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: hook_tests_start
title: Start hook tests for a post
